description: This file defines the DefinedNames class responsible for reading named ranges and expressions from an ODS spreadsheet within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It parses XML data to extract named ranges and expressions, converting addresses and formulas, and adds defined names to the spreadsheet.

classes.name: DefinedNames
classes.description: A class responsible for reading and processing named ranges and expressions from an ODS spreadsheet document.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Main method that reads both named ranges and expressions from the XML data.

methods.name: readDefinedRanges
methods.description: Parses and adds named ranges defined in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: readDefinedExpressions
methods.description: Parses and adds named expressions (formulas) defined in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: addDefinedName
methods.description: Creates and adds a named reference to the spreadsheet, considering sheet scope.
